hotspots.title: International Border
hotspots.note: About 2,400 km from Gujarat through Rajasthan and Punjab to Jammu; fenced, guarded by the BSF.

hotspots.title: Line of Control
hotspots.note: About 740 km military line from the Shimla Agreement; guarded by the Army.

hotspots.title: AGPL, Siachen
hotspots.note: About 110 km on the Saltoro Ridge north of NJ9842; held by India since Op Meghdoot (1984).

hotspots.title: Sir Creek
hotspots.note: 96 km tidal estuary in the Rann of Kutch; the boundary decides the maritime boundary and EEZs.

hotspots.title: CPEC
hotspots.note: Khunjerab Pass through Gilgit-Baltistan to Gwadar near Hormuz; India opposes it as a violation of sovereignty.

hotspots.title: Indus rivers
hotspots.note: Indus, Jhelum and Chenab (Western) and Ravi, Beas and Sutlej (Eastern); the Western rivers cross Indian territory first.

hotspots.title: Attari–Wagah and Kartarpur
hotspots.note: The only crossings for people and goods; both closed since 2025.
